newsitem.title: USA: AFTER THE BELL - Adaptec higher.
newsitem.headline: AFTER THE BELL - Adaptec higher.

text.p: Adaptec Inc was rose to 35-1/8 in after-hours trading from a close of 34-3/4 on the Nasdaq Stock Market in reaction to the release of its quarterly earnings, dealers said Tuesday.
"Adaptec is the only thing that's moving," said one of them. "Everything else is secondary."

The company, which makes network products for computer manufacturers, reported fourth quarter earnings of $0.50 a share before a $0.10 charge, compared to $0.37 for the same period last year. The stock rose 1-1/8 during regular trade.
Printronix Inc was trading 1/4 higher from its Nasdaq close of 12-3/8 after it reported earnings of $0.42 a share for the first quarter against $0.16 a year ago.
"It's trading just a little," the dealer said.
The New York Stock Exchange said session one had a volume of 30,100 shares against 88,800 the previous day. Session two had 3.6 million shares against 1.96 million on Monday, it added.
